A replicate's burned area by fuel type, with its base fuel type

area_by_fuel_base.Rd

Returns a replicate's area_by_fuel_ha (from parse_dynamic_fire_logs()) with its base column, the base fuel type of each fuel type in the run's own FuelTypeTable. A replicate parsed before landisutils 0.0.168 carries only fuel_code, the raw FuelType map value, which is the fuel-type index + 1; its base is then decoded through defaultFuelTypeTable() – right for a run whose FuelTypeTable kept the default indices – and that assumption is announced once per session.

Usage

area_by_fuel_base(d)

Arguments

d

A replicate's area_by_fuel_ha data frame.

Value

d as a data frame with a base column.

Details

This is the decoding loss_from_stats()'s area-by-fuel term and plot_calibration_area_by_fuel() apply, exported so that a figure drawn outside the package reads simulated fuel types the same way.
